about_the_game:
Jimmy, captain of the deep-sea research vessel Trilobite, leads his crew—including his younger brother, Jack—to investigate an unidentified signal. But unlike previous missions, the newly assigned, enigmatic commander appears to have ulterior motives…

Sea Blindness is a 2D pixel-art narrative RPG Game. In the year 2064, players assume the role of Jimmy, a deep-sea researcher who becomes entangled in a mysterious incident only to discover he's trapped inside a video game. Together with the player, Jimmy must navigate this digital realm to rescue his crewmates and ultimately restore balance to the game world.

Game Features:

  • Self-Aware NPCs: Characters gain consciousness and collaborate with players to complete problems.

  • Fourth-Wall-Breaking Gameplay: The game dynamically generates special files on your local PC as part of the narrative experience.

  • Intuitive Controls: Simple keyboard and mouse interactions drive progression.

  • Immersive Audio: Headphones recommended for full atmospheric impact.

Controls:

  • WASD: Character movement

  • E: Interact with objects

  • Mouse: Click/Drag to interact with files and UI elements

Detailed Instructions for Game File Panel Operations：

  • Click the Game File icon with your mouse to open/close the Panel.

  • Click the File icon with your mouse to open the File.

  • Hold and drag the File icon to the desired folder to move its location.

When the game notifies you of a new email message, why not check your computer desktop? ;)

Known Bug:
In some cases, dragging Jimmy’s file into the Submarine Indoor folder for the first time may not trigger the intended sound effect.

This bug does not affect gameplay progression.

Sincerely apologize if it impacts your experience!
